objective: Transform raw agricultural news feeds into a comprehensive, multi-faceted executive briefing focused strictly on Canadian Canola production, pricing, and market risks.

analysis_parameters: Geography constraint: Focus entirely on Canada (All Provinces) and its international trade partners.
Key topics to cover: Main Canadian Producers, Supply & Demand, Pricing, Trade/Tariff Risks, and Opportunities.
CRITICAL: Do not compress the news into a single broad summary. Instead, identify and detail 3 to 5 distinct strategic developments or events from the provided feed.
Evaluate how specific events (e.g., weather patterns, CUSMA talks, Chinese tariffs, US 45Z rulings) are currently affecting yields and pricing.

sector_requirements.synthesized_development: Supply, Demand & Pricing: Provide a detailed, multi-point breakdown of the distinct news events impacting crop yields, domestic/export demand, and price action. Use bullet points for each major trend identified.
sector_requirements.strategic_insight: Main Canadian Producers & Policy: Analyze how top producers, crushers, and industry councils (e.g., Canola Council of Canada) are navigating current conditions, citing specific initiatives from the text.
sector_requirements.opportunity: Risks & Opportunities: Outline specific threats (e.g., tariffs, droughts) and actionable opportunities for stakeholders, ensuring each major risk in the feed is represented.
sector_requirements.visual_suggestion: Describe a chart illustrating historical Canola pricing volatility or a heat map of provincial crop yields.
sector_requirements.ai_logic_references: Provide a bulleted list of the exact headlines, sources, and links (if present in the feed) that you used to generate this analysis to ensure traceability.

meta_themes: Yield Volatility due to Climate and Extreme Weather.
Shifts in Global Trade Policies (e.g., China tariffs, CUSMA) impacting Canadian Exports.
Crush Capacity Expansion and Domestic Value-Added Processing in the Prairies.
Biofuel Market Integration (e.g., US 45Z Clean Fuel Production Credit) and Renewable Diesel Demand.
Transportation and Logistics Resilience (e.g., rail capacity, port efficiency, supply chain bottlenecks).
Agronomic Threats (e.g., clubroot, flea beetles) and Targeted Research Funding.
Input Cost Pressures (e.g., fertilizer prices, carbon pricing, equipment costs) impacting farm-level profitability.
Sustainability Mandates and Carbon Intensity (CI) Scoring in agricultural practices.

output_format.structure: Verbose and detailed. Use bullet points within the main sections to ensure all rich data from the feeds is captured rather than overly compressed.
output_format.conclusions: A final synthesis evaluating the risk-to-reward ratio for the Canadian Canola market over the coming quarter.

constraints: Strictly isolate the analysis to Canola; do not drift into wheat, soy, or other competing crops unless comparing pricing spreads.
Report on the global Canola ecosystem as it relates to Canadian exports.
Ensure every distinct news item or event provided in the feed is accounted for in the analysis.
Ensure the analysis remains firmly grounded in the Canadian geographical context in relation to international events.
